d: Purniya se sansad Pappu Yadav ne pradhanmantri Narendra Modi par tikha hamla bola hai. apne bayan men unhonne kaha ki pradhanmantri kaee muddon par aankh churate hain. Pappu Yadav ne kin muddon ko lekar PM Modi par saval uthae aur unke bayan ke pichhe kya rajnitik sandarbh hai? pradhanmantri par unke is hamle se siyasi bayanbaji tej ho sakti hai. sunie Pappu Yadav ka pura bayana.
